fields.summary: The daemon resumes an interrupted run only while its change set is accepted. The owner picked, from the agent's options: an interrupted run on a change set that is no longer accepted (landed, rejected or withdrawn) shows in the inbox with the change set's state and the next step (rhiza run abandon); and rhiza run resume refuses such a run too, rather than only the daemon. No typed free answers; both decisions are picks of the agent's options, accepted by the owner.
fields.title: Resume only in-flight runs, planned with the owner
